question_text: Discuss whether adding a GPU will always speed up an application that generates many rendered images but also performs sequential control tasks.
adaptation_rationale: Retains rendering/hardware trade off while limiting demand toexplicitCPU/GPU design, task division, data sharing and coordinated execution.
solution: A GPU can execute many suitable rendering operations in parallel.; A CPU remains suitable for sequential/control-heavy work.; Tasks must be divided and coordinated between the processors.; Data transfers/memory access and workload size affect whether GPU use saves time.; A justified conclusion rejects a universal speed up guarantee and ties the choice to the actual workload.
